summary: Signed-distance collision/penalty metric. Given a target position a2, computes the delta against the owner position (this+0x0/0x4/0x8), takes a signed dot product against a direction vector at this+0x20/0x24/0x28, and applies directional bias thresholds at this+0x58 (negative side) and this+0x5C (positive side). It then projects a2 onto the line segments from the owner position to two reference sub-struct positions (via pointers *(this+0x110) and *(this+0x10C)), returning 10.0 when either reference has zero length, and finally returns the maximum of the biased signed distance, both line-projection margins, and abs(Y-delta) minus 3.0.

operations.description: Compute delta vector v15/v16/v17 = a2 - owner position (this+0x0, this+0x4, this+0x8).
Compute signed dot product v3 = delta . direction, where the direction vector components are read from this+0x20, this+0x24, this+0x28.
When v3 >= 0.0, base result = v3 - this+0x5C; otherwise base result = -(v3 + this+0x58); the two bias thresholds select the sign-side offset.
Dereference pointer at this+0x110 to obtain sub-struct A position (offsets +0x0/+0x4/+0x8), compute its delta to the owner position, and take its length via sqrt of the squared components.
When the sub-struct A length is 0.0, return 10.0.
Compute v18 = (unit vector to sub-struct A) . delta - length; when it exceeds the current result, adopt it as the new result.
Dereference pointer at this+0x10C to obtain sub-struct B position (offsets +0x0/+0x4/+0x8), compute its delta and sqrt length.
When the sub-struct B length is 0.0, return 10.0.
Compute v19 = (unit vector to sub-struct B) . delta - length; adopt it as the result when it is larger.
Compute v20 = fabs(Y-delta v16) - 3.0; when it exceeds the current result, return it.
Return the running maximum of all distance/penalty terms computed above.

Four globals (flt_59E43C, flt_59E440, flt_59E478, flt_59E5FC) are listed by extraction as read here but never appear in the raw source text; their role in the distance computation is unknown.
The two sub-struct pointers at this+0x110 and this+0x10C are unnamed; which geometry (strut endpoints) each represents is unknown.
The 10.0 sentinel and the 3.0 Y-axis margin are unexplained constants.
Direction vector and bias thresholds at this+0x20..0x28, this+0x58, this+0x5C are read-only here; their writers are external.
